plan.title: Liver drug treatment vs control: STAR/featureCounts DE + pathways
plan.analytical_narrative: The data is a bulk RNA-seq liver study with raw integer gene-level counts from STAR+featureCounts, 3 treated vs 3 control samples, unpaired, single batch, human (n=12000 genes x 6 samples). Following the grounded DESeq2 procedure: QC sample structure first (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library sizes) to confirm the treated/control samples separate and no outlier sample or batch structure confounds the comparison; minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=3 samples, the smallest group size); DESeq2 median-of-ratios normalization built into the model (no pre-normalization of the raw counts, and no tximport since these are gene-level STAR/featureCounts counts, not transcript quantifications); explicit factor releveling with control as the reference so log2FoldChange is treated-vs-control; DESeq2 Wald test with apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control coefficient; Benjamini-Hochberg FDR at alpha=0.05 with independent filtering, and the p-value histogram inspected as a diagnostic. With only 3 replicates per group the test is explicitly underpowered (per rule R-0017/R-0094): the report step states the expected power limitation and treats an edgeR quasi-likelihood run as a robustness cross-check, reporting the overlap of the two gene sets as the higher-confidence result rather than either list alone. Because strandedness of the STAR/featureCounts run is not recorded in the profile, the QC step also flags this as a caveat rather than silently trusting the count table. Downstream, the DESeq2 Wald statistic (a stated, disputed-rule choice) ranks all tested genes for preranked fgsea against the MSigDB Hallmark human gene sets (2026.1, staged locally) as the primary enrichment pass, with Reactome human pathways (staged locally) as the confirmatory second collection — both with min/max set size 15-500 and BH-adjusted, gene symbols mapped to Entrez via org.Hs.eg.db with the unmapped share reported. No over-representation analysis is planned unless the final significant gene count clears ~50 genes, given the small-n design. The final report step consolidates DE tables (unshrunken and shrunken LFC, SE), fit diagnostics (MA plot, dispersion plot), the enrichment tables with leading-edge genes, the power caveat, and a full reproducibility record (session info, seed, package/collection versions).
